lines.t: I've spent too many days
Living in the numbness
I fell asleep and forgot your ways
And was it peace in the silence?
Yet you didn't leave me in my slumber
Did not let darkness cradle me
Your mercy cut where I was numb
A healing blade of faithful love
You saw the sickness in my heart
And still your love would not depart
No shadow deep, no hidden stain
Could make you turn your face away
Faithful in the wound
Faithful in the breaking
Even when I cause you pain
Your love for me remains the same
You won't let me go
You won't leave me lost
Your mercy holds me close
No matter what it costs
You gave yourself up to torture and suffering
You didn't hold back, you gave up everything
There's no sin so dark you won't forgive
Your love and mercy have no end
When I am blind, you help me stay
When I am bound, you set me free
There's nothing you won't do
To lead me back to you
Faithful in the wound
Faithful in the breaking
Even when I cause you pain
Your love for me remains the same
You won't let me go
You won't leave me lost
Your mercy holds me close
No matter what it costs
I know your correction is love
Healing flames from above
Exposing lies and unbelief
Till only truth remains in me
Oh Lord, come and search my heart
Shine your light into the dark
I will trust your endless grace
Through every trial I face
Faithful in the wound
Faithful in the breaking
When my pride shatters
You give me grace
I'm held deep inside your ring
Your strong embrace
So I offer up all my weakness
You alone are my righteousness
You will not leave me
You will not leave me
You will never leave me
